integer.failure: reject before JSON encoding with result path and explicit conversion guidance

bytes.failure: reject malformed base64 or payloads above the existing byte limit

sequence.logicalKind: list or variadic tuple of one contracted item kind
sequence.composition: apply each item rule at its result path

tuple.logicalKind: fixed-length heterogeneous tuple of contracted values
tuple.decodedAs: JavaScript array with one contracted value per position
tuple.composition: require exact length and apply each item rule at its result index; an empty tuple is valid

union.logicalKind: one value matching a nonempty set of contracted alternatives
union.wire: the selected alternative's existing wire encoding
union.composition: require at least one matching alternative; reject a contract if the same wire value can match alternatives with different decoded representations; order has no semantic effect
union.failure: reject an empty or one-option union during contract construction; reject a value that matches no alternative with its path

record.composition: apply each field rule at its result path

ndarray-float16.wire: codecVersion 1 ndarray Arrow envelope; JSON fallback stays explicit
ndarray-float16.decodedAs: JavaScript numeric scalar or nested array
ndarray-float16.conversion: decode each Arrow Uint16 storage word as IEEE 754 binary16 before reshape

torch-float16.wire: codecVersion 1 torch.tensor envelope containing ndarray envelope
torch-float16.conversion: reuse ndarray-float16 rule for nested value

prototypeBoundary: Only float16 scientific values use the new ndarray contract. Existing Arrow int64 values may decode as bigint and keep their current rules.

contractLimits.namedRecordAliases: inline nonrecursive aliases within the depth limit
contractLimits.recursiveAliases: unsupported until a reviewed reference-graph contract exists

compatibility.unsafeInteger: previous clients could round; new producers reject
compatibility.generatedWrappers: regenerate when callable-contract code consumes revision 2
